===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/seɪlz/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-sales.ogg|a=US}}
* {{homophones|en|sails}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪlz|s=1}}
* {{hyph|en|sales}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|p}}

# {{plural of|en|sale}}
# The activities involved in selling goods or services.
#: {{ux|en|He's likable and motivated: perfect for a career in '''sales'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|We have a '''sales''' training program beginning this Monday.}}
# The amount or value of goods and services sold.
#: {{ux|en|'''Sales''' were up 12% over last year.}}

====Usage notes====
* Often used attributively.
